verdict.rationale: Install docs cover only Claude Code: a plugin marketplace install and a project-local `.claude/skills/` copy. For anything else, the only documented route is a generic fallback of pasting a single `SKILL.md` into any chat to run it as a mode. That gives minimal cross-agent portability but no named per-harness instructions. Missing for 10: documented install steps for Codex, Cursor or other named harnesses, a way to install the whole collection outside Claude Code, and independent corroboration that it works in other agents.
